declarations.name: VeraCheckbox
declarations.description: Serves the author's own <input type="checkbox">, which stays the form participant (submit, reset, disabled, autofill and back/forward restore are the platform's) and works before the script runs; there is no default render. Draws the box on the input itself, a 24px target at any size, with a check and a dash in the platform's own states. Adds a mixed state, kept in step with the input's indeterminate property. It never labels: wrap it in a <label>, give the input a <label for>, or use <vera-field>.

attributes.name: data-vera-look
attributes.description: "none": drops the look, so the engine's own control shows (and the author styles it). Read when the input is served and copied onto it, unless the input has its own; to change it later, set it on the input. Not observed.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Mixed: sets the input's indeterminate property, which has no attribute of its own. A click on a mixed box is the platform's (it clears mixed and flips checked) and the attribute goes with it; a click a listener cancels keeps both. Observed.

declarations.name: VeraSwitch
declarations.description: Serves the author's own <input type="checkbox"> as a switch: the platform's switch attribute where the engine has it, role="switch" where it does not, never both. The input stays the form participant and submits exactly as a checkbox does. Draws a track and a thumb on the input itself, a 24px target at any size; the thumb moves to the inline end when on, mirrors under rtl, and jumps instead of sliding under reduced motion. Its label never changes with its state: wrap it in a <label>, give the input a <label for>, or use <vera-field>.

attributes.name: data-vera-look
attributes.description: "none": drops the look, so the engine's own control shows (and the author styles it). Read when the input is served and copied onto it, unless the input has its own; to change it later, set it on the input. Not observed.
